judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 correctly identifies the Hawaiian meaning of “huli” as “to turn/reverse” and accurately describes the well-known “huli huli chicken” grilling/turning idea (with largely plausible sauce details), though it includes at least one dubious extra-language claim. Candidate 3 also gets the Hawaiian meaning and huli huli chicken mostly right, but it adds likely incorrect Mandarin/Swahili meanings, reducing reliability. Candidate 2 stays closer to a general Hawaiian “turn/reverse” translation but is more vague and omits the key “huli huli” food connection. Candidate 4 makes multiple incorrect or highly dubious claims about “huli” (especially conflating it with imu/kalua preparations and adding unsupported non-Hawaiian cuisine meanings), making it the weakest.
